answer: One purse can underwrite many voting keys if funding is unfenced. Admission cuts a sable wick that can feed only one live key and parks three crystal chips in escrow. Each chip redeems only after a 4-hour 55-minute silence and at a different height parity. Chips post on a terrace board with chip-id, wick-hash, and height. The key locks 26 POA for 8 epochs and pays 0.42 POA per chip. Peers rebuild the wick cutoff and chip calendar. A wick feeding two keys, an early-redeemed crystal chip, or a double-posted terrace slot slashes 29 percent to the spotting assayer and freezes the key 5 epochs.
